name: Headcount
definition: Employees (permanent, fixed-term, working students) employed on the last day of the month, including people on leave. Contractors are not employees.

name: Full-time equivalents
definition: Sum of contracted FTE of the headcount.

name: Hires
definition: Employees whose first day falls in the month, rehires included.

name: Voluntary turnover, trailing 12 months
definition: Voluntary leavers (last day in the window) over the average month-end headcount in the window.

name: New starters gone within 90 days
definition: Employees whose last day falls in the month and who left within 90 days of their first day.

name: Paid below 90 percent of band
definition: Share of the headcount whose base salary is below 0.9 of their level's band midpoint for their country.

name: Open requisitions
definition: Requisitions open on the last day of the month.

name: Median days to fill
definition: Median days from opening to filling, over requisitions filled in the trailing 3 months.
